strings.lore_help_tabmutations: Read creature mutation effects and their current values. This tab does not change world rules.
strings.lore_help_tabmodifiers: Read creature modifier effects and their current values. This tab does not change world rules.
strings.lore_help_tabaspects: Read boss aspect effects and their current values. This tab does not change world rules.
strings.lore_help_tabdifficulty: Read the active difficulty settings. This tab does not change them.
strings.lore_help_previous: Show the previous page in this lore tab. Stops at the first page.
strings.lore_help_next: Show the next page in this lore tab. Stops at the last page.
strings.lore_help_close: Close the read-only lore window without changing world rules.
strings.recap_help_older: Select an older recorded death. Playback pauses and returns to the beginning of that recording.
strings.recap_help_newer: Select a newer recorded death. Playback pauses and returns to the beginning of that recording.
strings.recap_help_play: Play or pause the selected recording. Play restarts a recording that has reached its end. Requires a recorded death.
strings.recap_help_back: Move back one second in the selected recording, stopping at its beginning. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.recap_help_forward: Move forward one second in the selected recording, stopping at its end. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.recap_help_death: Jump to the moment of death in the selected recording and pause playback.
strings.recap_help_previous_hit: Jump to the previous recorded hit and pause playback. Stops at the first hit.
strings.recap_help_next_hit: Jump to the next recorded hit and pause playback. Stops at the last hit.
strings.recap_help_close: Close the recap window and stop playback. Recorded deaths are kept.
strings.recap_help_time: Enter a clip time in seconds within the selected recording. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.recap_help_timeline: Drag through the selected recording from start to end. Seeking pauses playback.
